# -------------------------------
# PowerShell: OAuthLogin via Gateway
# -------------------------------

# 1️⃣ 准备 GraphQL 请求体
$bodyObject = @{
    query = 'mutation OAuthLogin($provider: OAuthProvider!, $idToken: String!) {
  oauthLogin(provider: $provider, idToken: $idToken) {
    accessToken
    refreshToken
    user {
      id
      email
      role
    }
  }
}'
    variables = @{
        provider = "GOOGLE"
        idToken = "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IjdiZjU5NTQ4OWEwYmIxNThiMDg1ZTIzZTdiNTJiZjk4OTFlMDQ1MzgiLCJ0eXAiOiJKV1QifQ..iyftCKbLL5Yy8Za8zGlakaY2NdssO_7MOOE16gES_KXvUSgpXK_PBHamh1UvXRSOCHSsxNsULsXbiYcuh3tp0Bd2IG01fNTRm4mK6QF_PutKcsDsTHQvBbDUeMbVfcBZpwdsZEiCOJoejh6UwphALg-vZRT7yOFkYGvAnM8KOFBxlDuYAU7xcNxKv3i1nRinf1kauEmht3GYMLmB0vm5EGM5_hmzwvDjXWePU0JugnR55OVGdSM7WgycUIztU6LS9W8Nrs3k3IeuIDkuv9FjaDafSQSVb90AJhQdvEmvgBoY1OZaC2a6gkKuNkHDWaHPKuvBVpWJ7kbKNWoeLSSQcg"
    }
}

# ✅ 关键：必须 ConvertTo-Json 且 Depth 至少 5
$bodyJson = $bodyObject | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress

# 2️⃣ 初始化 session（保存 cookie）
$session = New-Object Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession

# 3️⃣ 发送 POST 请求到 Gateway
$response = Invoke-RestMethod `
    -Uri "http://localhost:4000/graphql" `
    -Method POST `
    -Headers @{ "Content-Type" = "application/json" } `
    -Body $bodyJson `
    -WebSession $session

# 4️⃣ 打印 GraphQL 返回结果
Write-Host "=== Response ==="
$response | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Write-Host

# 5️⃣ 打印 Cookie 信息
Write-Host "=== Cookies ==="
$session.Cookies.GetCookies("http://localhost:4000") | ForEach-Object {
    "{0} = {1}" -f $_.Name, $_.Value
}
